archetypes.name: dyn-bgjob-recovery
archetypes.rationale: The launcher now distinguishes live registry identity from stale terminal result artifacts.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the changed Step 5c launcher and harness for recovery behavior across live, missing, and cleared registry states. Confirm stale result envs cannot short-circuit a fresh launch while symlink and non-regular-file guards remain fail-closed. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
